docs/rom/bn4.md:38.title: Map tables
docs/rom/bn4.md:38.how: Verify: `build/host/cyberworld --headless --rom-dir DIR --atlas OUT:x1`, BN4 beside BN6 in DIR, draws every map with its walls, heights and triggers.

docs/rom/bn4.md:40.title: Songs
docs/rom/bn4.md:40.how: A table of song headers (tracks 0-16, a voice group pointer, a pointer per track) found by its shape; the same search finds BN5's at its known `0x155BF4`. 33 songs of four tracks or more, 0x00-0x21 but 0x0E: its music.

docs/rom/bn4.md:43.title: The encounter check and the roll
docs/rom/bn4.md:43.how: Verified in romlab: the check patched to `ldr r0,=record; bx lr` starts that battle from Lan's room (`tools/bn4_lab.py battle`).

docs/rom/bn4.md:44.title: Battle records
docs/rom/bn4.md:44.how: Verified in romlab: ACDC Area's third record (`0x08100168`, `--record 90:0:2`) fields Billy (50 HP) and a Mettaur (40) at its panels (5, 2) and (6, 3); a record written with enemy 7 at (4, 1) and 13 at (5, 2) fields VolGear (80 HP) and Billy (50) there; enemy 1 written with kind 5 is a rock.

docs/rom/bn4.md:45.title: Enemy records
docs/rom/bn4.md:45.how: Found by the HP read in romlab: battles forced with enemy 1, 3, 5 and 13 alone held 40, 100, 180 and 50 in one RAM word of the enemy's (`0x0203B27C` that time); the one table of the ROM with those at a fixed stride is this one. +0 element << 12 \| HP (BN6's first word's form: VolGear's `0x1050`, Fire, 80), +3 the kind (4 a virus, 8 a Navi), +4 the family or the Navi's number, +5 the version (0-5), +10 a u16 attack (Mettaur 10, Mettaur3 160). 120 viruses and 95 Navi records.

docs/rom/bn4.md:46.title: Chip records
docs/rom/bn4.md:46.how: BN6's getChip (bn6f) found in BN4 by its bytes, its literal this table.

docs/rom/bn4.md:47.title: Chip names
docs/rom/bn4.md:47.how: BN4's text spells letters and digits as BN6 and BN5 do (A `0x0B`, a `0x26`, digits from `0x01`); "annon" found by its letters' spacing, then Cannon.

docs/rom/bn4.md:48.title: Enemy names
docs/rom/bn4.md:48.how: Mettaur found as Cannon was: viruses 1-126 (Mettaur, MettEX, Mettaur2 and on), the Navis from 128, four entries each, Duo at 224, Bass and BassXX at 228-230, the DS forms 240-252; each name the enemy record of its id.

docs/rom/bn4.md:49.title: Battle backgrounds
docs/rom/bn4.md:49.how: Verified in romlab (`.build/bn4-bg/`, not kept): +5 = 0x10 and 0x03 drew two backgrounds, and 0x10 with its three tables' entries pointed at 0x03's drew 0x03's frame byte for byte; on 0x90:0 with +5 0xFF the same frame as +5 = 4.

docs/rom/bn4.md:52.title: Chip records' fields and Souls
docs/rom/bn4.md:52.how: Verified in romlab: with flags 0x14 and 0x19 set UNITE lit after AirShot, WindSoul its icon, and the used Souls' word (`0x0203BF88`) 4 after OK; with flag 0x14 alone UNITE stood grey.

docs/rom/bn4.md:53.title: Souls in battle
docs/rom/bn4.md:53.how: Verified in romlab (`.build/bn4souls/`, not kept): with Red Sun's flags set and the save's byte written, WindSoul united after AirShot, the unison played, MegaMan drew WindSoul's sprite with turns 3 under his face, 2 and 1 at the next screens, normal again after the third; each of the twelve given Wind's kind and flag in the ROM's tables united the same way (NaviStats +0x24 its number, its name over the field), and each one's charged shot ran (a `probe` on its power attack and on its family's first instruction, every frame of the attack: a held B of 300 frames, a frozen Mettaur that cannot reset the charge; JunkSoul's family the battle's chip).

docs/rom/bn4.md:55.title: Virus families
docs/rom/bn4.md:55.how: Verified in romlab: a battle of Mettaur, Billy and Spikey held objects of types 0x02, 0x13 and 0x17, their enemy ids at +0xF and HP 40, 50 and 60, their states run 6 to 9, and MegaMan lost 10 HP, Mettaur's attack.

docs/rom/bn4.md:57.title: Spikey's and Shrimpy's attacks and their spawns in BN6's engine
docs/rom/bn4.md:57.how: Verify: `python3 tools/xrecipe_bn4.py` (each block's CRC32, each pair compared again), and headless with `--dev quiet,bn4families`, `foes 2C6@52` (Spikey) or `foes 2CC@52` (Shrimpy) against MegaMan idle: Spikey's fireball runs its row and strikes him for 30 (V1), Shrimpy's bubble bounces along its row and strikes him for 30; the autopilot deletes each.

docs/rom/bn4.md:58.title: The battle's objects, collision and AI data, panels
docs/rom/bn4.md:58.how: Not found: an AI index or AI state (BN4 runs an enemy by its type), the role of the object's +0x2A, the freeze and bubble BN6 has.

docs/rom/bn4.md:59.title: Walla, Elmperor and CirKill in BN6's engine
docs/rom/bn4.md:59.how: Verify: `python3 tools/xrecipe_bn4.py` (0 decisions open for the three, each pair compared again); `CYBERWORLD_AUTOPILOT=1 python3 build.py shot --scene emu --run-depth 3 --dev bn4families --input "200:,0:foes 2D2@52,1400:"` (Walla; Elmperor `2D8`, CirKill `2DE`): each on the field, its attack striking MegaMan for its record's damage (20, 30, 30), deleted.

docs/rom/bn4.md:61.title: The differential's BN4 trace
docs/rom/bn4.md:61.how: Verify: `python3 build.py xdiff bn4_mettaur_control` (900 fight frames by that timer, its Custom screens passed from that window, the run order read to that end: PASS, the same in both runs).

docs/rom/bn4.md:62.title: BN4's Navis
docs/rom/bn4.md:62.how: Verified in romlab (`.build/bn4-navis/`, not kept): GutsMan V1 alone against MegaMan (enemy 132 at (5, 1), MegaMan's HP held) ran CurAction 6 and 7 in turn (MegaMan's 67, a step of about 60 frames), 10 (MegaMan's 70, a machine gun's burst, frames 398-481 and 849-922 of the fight) and 8 (68, a dash, at 1237); his AI data side 1's (`0x02035BE0`), its +0x64 and +0x65 the decision's sub-states (0 and 8; 0, 4 and 12 seen) and +0x70 and +0x71 the attack's (0, 4, 8; 0, 4).
